name: satori
description: A single UserPromptSubmit hook that injects a compact per-turn reminder made of characters, with no translations: each character carries its meaning whole, names the target state rather than a prohibition, costs a few hundred tokens per turn in place of paragraph-scale reminder prose, and doubles as the vocabulary for naming a failure. Not an agreement and not enforcement machinery: the plugin accepts that we control nothing; we can be the river or be the rock.
